head: Pinu Club is a free AI language learning app with speaking feedback
dek: Pinu Club is a new iPhone app for learning a language in short lessons, with AI feedback on your pronunciation as you speak words and sentences. It was #88 in Education on the US App Store's free chart on 15 November.
details: Lessons cover listening, reading, translation and speaking along a set path, with a streak calendar, optional reminders, weekly leagues and a vocabulary Bingo game. The listing says it has no in-app purchases; you can start as a guest and sign in with Apple, Google or email to keep your progress. The app's own screens are in English, Spanish and Simplified Chinese. It's made by Christopher Frantz Schulz and came out on 27 October.
where: iPhone and iPad, App Store, free with no in-app purchases
means: If you want to practise speaking a new language for a few minutes a day without a subscription, this is a free one to try.
todo: Start as a guest to try it, then sign in if you want to keep your streak and progress.
